p04_review: No new registry packages, features or lockfile changes. Original portable scheduler/wait core, IRQ-safe context bridge, AP bootstrap, per-CPU descriptors/timers, FS/FXSAVE state and synchronous shootdown implementation. Host invariants and actual 1/2/4-CPU plus missing-AP guest scenarios qualify different boundaries.
p05_review: No new registry packages or registry feature changes. Cargo.lock adds only local ABI/sys/rt/native-fixture members. Kernel depends on schema and original image parser, never user runtime. Freestanding native ELF commands pin lto=off to avoid mixing prebuilt core kernel code-model flags with small code-model application modules.
p06_review: No new dependency, feature or lockfile change. Original PCI/VirtIO, block/GPT/FAT32/ext2/VFS and host formatter/auditor code. Supporting references provide device/disk contracts only. Guest DMA and filesystem execution require actual profile evidence separate from portable tests.

Installed MSVC/SDK compile an independent Windows fixture; original DLLs use pinned Rust/LLD without CRT or host API dependencies. Abort-only compiler exception handler is not unwind support.
p10_review: Original workspace-only compiler TLS, dynamic DLL lifecycle, exception/waits/async adapters and scoped C runtime; no registry dependency versions or features changed.
